{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id entries, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Compute response rates by sex
response_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

# Compute response rates by sex and severity
response_by_sex_severity = trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute response rates by sex and arm
response_by_sex_arm = trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'arm'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Print results
print("Overall response rate by sex:")
print(response_by_sex)
print("\nResponse rate by sex and severity:")
print(response_by_sex_severity)
print("\nResponse rate by sex and arm:")
print(response_by_sex_arm)"}
